Article 3

Point a
What is meant by trafficking in persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, falsification of documents or identity, fraud, abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control or other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.

Point b
What is meant by exploitation is an act with or without the consent of the victim which includes prostitution, forced labor or service, slavery or practices similar to slavery, oppression, extortion, utilization of sexual physical reproductive organs or unlawfully, transferring/utilizing labor or transplanting organs and or body tissues or utilizing the labor or ability of a person by another party to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.

Point c
Sufficiently clear.

Point d
What is meant by witness is a person who sees, hears and experiences events of violence and human rights violations.

Point e
Mediation is carried out for cases of domestic violence that fall into the category of complaint offenses as regulated in Law No. 23 of 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence.

Article 12

Paragraph (1)
Point a
What is meant by complaint service is a series of actions carried out by the organizer of the integrated service institution to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families and/or the community.

Point b
What is meant by health services is an effort that includes promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.

Point c
What is meant by legal assistance is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of assisting witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children that is gender sensitive.

Point d
What is meant by repatriation is returning women and child victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point or from the receiving area to the area of origin.

Point e
What is meant by social rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

What is meant by social reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with family, substitute family or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for victims.

Point f
What is meant by assistance service is that victims have the right to be accompanied by social workers at the investigation, prosecution or examination level.

Paragraph (2)
What is meant by minimum service standards is a performance benchmark for integrated service units in providing complaint handling services, health services, social rehabilitation, law enforcement and legal assistance, as well as repatriation and social reintegration for women and child victims of violence.

Paragraph (3)
Sufficiently clear.

Article 7

Paragraph (1)
Sufficiently clear.

Paragraph (2)
What is meant by Regional Action Plan is the stages of programs and activities for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including the worst forms of work for children that must be carried out by SKPD and UKPD in accordance with their duties and functions, prepared based on achievement targets within a period of 5 (five) years.

Article 8

1. The obligations and responsibilities of the community as referred to in Article 6 letter b, shall be implemented in the form of community participation.
2. Forms of community participation as referred to in paragraph (1), include:
a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children;
b. providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; and
c. participating in providing assistance and/or handling victims of acts of violence.
3. Forms of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2), shall be carried out responsibly in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

CHAPTER X

FINANCING

Article 25

Financing of the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence is sourced from:
a. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBD); and
b. other legitimate sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

Article 26

1. The regional government may provide financial assistance to community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations that implement protection of women and children from discrimination and acts of violence.
2. Financial assistance as referred to in paragraph (1), is in accordance with regional financial capacity, and is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations in the field of regional finance.

Article 22

Paragraph (1)
what is meant by guidance on the implementation of prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence is an effort undertaken by the regional government and the community to realize the achievement of the objectives of prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence.

What is meant by supervision of the implementation of prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence is a process of activities aimed at ensuring that efforts undertaken by the regional government and the community run efficiently and effectively in accordance with plans and provisions of laws and regulations.

Paragraph (2)
Sufficiently clear.

Paragraph (3)
Sufficiently clear.

Article 21

1. The regional government establishes partnerships with the business sector in the protection of women and children from acts of violence.
2. Partnership as referred to in paragraph (1) is conducted through:
a. notification of employment opportunity information for women victims of acts of violence;
b. education and training for women victims of acts of violence;
c. educational assistance for women and children victims of acts of violence who have been withdrawn from their education; and
d. fostering and increasing the economic independence of women victims of acts of violence.
3. Partnership as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2), shall be set forth in the form of an agreement.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS

Article 16

1. In the context of providing protection services to women and children from acts of violence, the regional government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.
2. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
3. Further provisions regarding the Organization and Work Procedures of P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), shall be stipulated by Regent Regulation.

Article 23

1. The regional government is obliged to conduct supervision of the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence.
2. Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), is conducted with professional, transparent, and accountable principles.

REGIONAL REGULATION OF BARITO KUALA REGENCY

NUMBER 4 OF 2015

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD

THE REGENT OF BARITO KUALA,

Considering:

a. that discrimination and violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights and crimes against humanity; b. that in the context of fulfilling the constitutional rights of women and children as well as to improve the quality of life of women and children is one of the mandatory affairs that is the duty, authority and responsibility of the regional government; c. that discrimination and violence against women and children in Barito Kuala Regency continues to increase and spread, causing community members to be unsafe in carrying out their lives, thus requiring integrated protection efforts; d. that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, and letter c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation on the Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence; In View of:

CHAPTER IX

GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

Article 22

1. The Regional Government is obliged to conduct guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection of women and children from acts of violence.
2. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1), includes:
a. guidelines and fulfillment standards;
b. technical guidance and training;
c. provision of facilities;
d. monitoring; and
e. evaluation.
3. Guidance as referred to in paragraph (2), is in order to realize the objectives of protection of women and children from acts of violence in accordance with minimum service standards implemented by SKPD and the community.
